Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: In the second step, the WebSurfer agent failed to correctly interpret the search results. While the search query "Alain Robbe-Grillet spouse" returned a result showing "Simone de Beauvoir" under the "Spouse" field, this was a hallucination or error in the displayed search snippet (likely due to the search engine confusing Alain Robbe-Grillet with his father, Jean Robbe-Grillet, who was married to Simone de Beauvoir). The WebSurfer agent accepted this incorrect information as fact without verifying it on the Wikipedia page or recognizing that Simone de Beauvoir was the wife of Jean Robbe-Grillet, not Alain. Consequently, it provided the wrong answer to the Planner.
